text: The urinalysis results show significant pyuria and bacteriuria but no evidence of malignancy or stones. Given your history of recurrent infections and right flank pain, do you experience any severe colicky pain radiating to your groin or any difficulty urinating? REQUEST TEST: Renal_Ultrasound.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Renal_Ultrasound: Findings consistent with previous imaging; multiple cysts present in the collecting ducts of the medulla. No obstruction, stones, or masses noted. No hydronephrosis. Kidneys appear otherwise unremarkable.

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound confirms multiple cysts in the medullary collecting ducts without obstruction or stones. Do you have a family history of kidney stones, cysts, or polycystic kidney disease? REQUEST TEST: CT Abdomen/Pelvis with contrast to better characterize the cysts and rule out malignancy.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CT Abdomen/Pelvis with contrast: Multiple cysts present in the collecting ducts of the medulla. No obstruction, stones, or masses noted. No hydronephrosis. Kidneys appear otherwise unremarkable.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney. The clinical presentation of hematuria and flank pain, combined with ultrasound and CT findings of multiple cysts in the medullary collecting ducts, is diagnostic. The absence of stones or masses on imaging rules out nephrolithiasis or malignancy as the primary cause.
